# Dictionary.com

> > Dictionary.com provides comprehensive language reference tools, word games, and educational resources for vocabulary building and word puzzles.

Dictionary.com offers a suite of free online word games and puzzle tools alongside its core dictionary and thesaurus services. The platform includes popular games like Anagram Solver, Word Search Maker, Crossword Solver, and Scrabble Word Finder, as well as casual puzzle games developed by Arkadium. Mobile apps are available for both Android and iPhone users.

## Key Topics

- Dictionary.com
- Anagram Solver
- Word games
- Crossword Solver
- Scrabble Word Finder
- Word Search Maker

- Free online games
- Vocabulary building
- Hurdle Game
- Mahjongg Dimensions
- Block Champ Game

## Help & Support

- [Dictionary.com Help Center](https://help.dictionary.com/): Help center for Dictionary.com and Thesaurus.com with FAQs and guides

## Word Game Tools

- [Anagram Solver Online - Free Online Game](https://play.dictionary.com/games/dictionary-anagram-solver): Free anagram solver tool for word games and puzzles by Arkadium

## Optional Games

- [10x10 Game - Free Online Game](https://play.dictionary.com/games/ten-x-ten): Tetris-like 10x10 grid puzzle game with block placement mechanics
- [Get 10 Ultimate - Free Online Game](https://play.dictionary.com/games/get-10-ultimate): Number puzzle game challenging players to reach 10 and beyond
